mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_id, email, password, nickname, name, phone, profile_img, provider, provider_id, email_verified, role, region, income_level) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{profileImg}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{emailVerified}, #{role}, #{region}, #{incomeLevel})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, profile_img = #{profileImg}, region = #{region}, income_level = #{incomeLevel}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
